ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a Central Sector Scheme with 100% funding from the Government of India. The scheme provides income support to all landholding farmer families across the country to supplement their financial needs for procuring various inputs related to agriculture and allied activities as well as domestic needs.
financial_assistance: Rs. 6,000 per year paid in three equal four-monthly installments of Rs. 2,000 directly into the bank accounts of eligible farmer families through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
benefits: Direct financial support of Rs. 6,000 annually per beneficiary family
Paid in 3 equal installments of Rs. 2,000 every four months
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) credited directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts
Helps meet farm input expenses and domestic necessities ahead of harvest seasons
eligibility_summary: All landholding farmer families having cultivable land in their names, subject to statutory exclusion criteria (such as income tax payers and institutional landholders).
exclusions: All institutional landholders
Farmer families in which one or more members belong to: Former and present holders of constitutional posts
Former and present Ministers, MPs, MLAs, MLCs, Mayors of Municipal Corporations, and Chairpersons of District Panchayats

Serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government Ministries, Departments, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), Autonomous bodies, Local bodies (excluding Multi Tasking Staff / Class IV / Group D employees)
All superannuated / retired pensioners whose monthly pension is Rs. 10,000 or more (excluding Class IV / Group D pensioners)
All persons who paid Income Tax in the last assessment year
Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with professional bodies and carrying out profession
documents_required: Aadhaar Card (mandatory)
Landholding document / Record of Rights (ROR) / Khasra Khatauni
Aadhaar-seeded active bank account passbook details
Active mobile number linked with Aadhaar
Citizenship proof and self-declaration of landholding
how_to_apply: Eligible farmers can apply online through the PM-KISAN portal (Farmers Corner > New Farmer Registration) or via local Common Service Centres (CSCs) and State Nodal Officers.

scheme_name: PM-USP - Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
ministry: Ministry of Education (Department of Higher Education)
description: The Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (PM-USP CSSS) provides financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher education after Class 12.
financial_assistance: Rs. 12,000 per annum at graduation level for the first 3 years of college, and Rs. 20,000 per annum at postgraduate level (or in 4th and 5th year for professional courses).
benefits: Scholarship of Rs. 12,000 per annum for undergraduate degree years (Years 1 to 3)
Scholarship of Rs. 20,000 per annum for postgraduate studies or 4th/5th year of 5-year integrated professional courses
Total 82,000 new scholarships awarded annually (divided equally: 41,000 for boys and 41,000 for girls)
Direct DBT transfer into student's verified bank account via National Scholarship Portal
eligibility_summary: Students scoring above 80th percentile in relevant stream in Class 12 board examination, pursuing regular degree course in recognized institution, with annual family income up to Rs. 4.5 Lakh.
exclusions: Students pursuing studies through correspondence, distance, or open university mode
Students receiving any other scholarship or fee reimbursement from Central or State Government
Students whose annual family gross income exceeds Rs. 4.5 Lakh
Students who failed in any academic year or do not maintain minimum 50% marks in annual university exams for renewal
documents_required: Aadhaar Card
Class 12 Passing Certificate and Marksheet
Valid Income Certificate issued by competent revenue authority (income <= Rs. 4.5 Lakh)
Proof of admission / Bonafide student certificate from recognized college/university
Student bank account passbook (Aadhaar seeded)
Caste / Disability certificate (if claiming reservation quota)
how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) under the Central Sector Schemes section.

scheme_name: AICTE - Swanath Scholarship Scheme (Technical Degree & Diploma)
ministry: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education
description: AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme is aimed at providing financial support to orphan children, children whose parents died due to Covid-19, or children of Armed Forces and Central Paramilitary Forces personnel martyred in action, pursuing technical degree or diploma courses in AICTE-approved institutions.
financial_assistance: Rs. 50,000 per annum lump sum amount paid for every year of study towards college fee, computers, books, equipment, and software.
benefits: Rs. 50,000 per annum fixed assistance for every year of regular study
Awarded for maximum 4 years for Degree students, and 3 years for Diploma students
Covers tuition fees, hostel expenses, books, equipment, and laptops
Credited directly via PFMS DBT into beneficiary student's bank account
eligibility_summary: Orphan students, or Covid-19 orphaned children, or children of martyred Armed/Paramilitary Forces personnel; enrolled in 1st year (or lateral entry 2nd year) in an AICTE-approved technical institution; family income not exceeding Rs. 8 Lakh per annum.

eligibility_criteria.target_group: Orphan, Covid-affected, or martyred personnel children pursuing technical education

exclusions: Students enrolled in non-AICTE approved institutions or non-technical general degree programs
Students admitted through management quota or non-merit process
Family income from all sources exceeding Rs. 8,00,000 per annum
Students availing duplicate benefits under similar Central/State scholarship schemes
documents_required: Death certificate of parents (for orphans or COVID-19 deceased parents)
Martyrdom certificate issued by Defence or Paramilitary authority
Family Income Certificate issued by competent authority (income <= Rs. 8 Lakh)
Admission letter / Bonafide certificate from AICTE-approved institution
Class 10 and Class 12 / Diploma mark sheets
Aadhaar Card and Bank Account details linked with Aadhaar
how_to_apply: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) during the active application cycle and get the application verified by the institute's nodal officer.

benefits: Cashless treatment at empanelled public and private hospitals
Cover of Rs. 5 lakh per family per year
Covers pre- and post-hospitalisation expenses as per scheme rules
No cap on family size, age or gender
description: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY provides cashless health insurance cover for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation to vulnerable families identified on deprivation and occupational criteria.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card
Ration Card / Family ID as applicable
Proof of residence and identity of family members
PM-JAY beneficiary card / e-card if already issued
eligibility_summary: Families identified as deprived / vulnerable under SECC 2011 criteria for rural and urban areas, and other categories notified by States/UTs.
exclusions: Families not identified under the notified SECC / State beneficiary list
Treatment at non-empanelled hospitals is not covered under the scheme
financial_assistance: Health cover of Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year on a family floater basis for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility on the beneficiary portal or at a Common Service Centre / empanelled hospital help desk, then complete e-KYC to get the Ayushman card.
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
source: National Health Authority - PM-JAY Guidelines (DRAFT - verify against official guideline before submission)

benefits: Assistance for construction of a pucca house
Toilet support through convergence with Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin
Unskilled wage support through convergence with MGNREGA
Support for LPG connection through convergence with PM Ujjwala Yojana
description: PMAY-G provides assistance to eligible rural households for construction of a pucca house with basic amenities, to households that are houseless or living in kutcha / dilapidated houses.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card
MGNREGA Job Card if available
Bank account details
Affidavit / self-declaration as required by the Gram Panchayat
Swachh Bharat Mission details for toilet construction
eligibility_summary: Rural households that are houseless or living in kutcha / dilapidated houses and identified through SECC 2011 and Awaas+ survey, subject to exclusion criteria.
exclusions: Households owning a pucca house or a motorised vehicle / mechanised agricultural equipment as per exclusion criteria
Households with a government employee member or an income-tax payer member, as per scheme exclusion rules
Households not in the Permanent Waitlist / Awaas+ list
financial_assistance: Rs. 1,20,000 in plain areas and Rs. 1,30,000 in hilly / difficult areas, released in instalments directly to the beneficiary.
how_to_apply: Eligible households are identified through the Permanent Waitlist. Check status on pmayg.nic.in or contact the Gram Panchayat / Block Development Office.
source: Ministry of Rural Development - PMAY-G Guidelines (DRAFT - verify against official guideline before submission)

benefits: Bank account with no minimum balance requirement
RuPay debit card with in-built accident insurance as per scheme rules
Direct Benefit Transfer of subsidies into the account
Overdraft up to Rs. 10,000 for eligible accounts, with preference to the woman account holder of the household
description: PMJDY is a national mission for financial inclusion to ensure access to banking, savings, remittance, credit, insurance and pension services for every unbanked household.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card
PAN Card or Form 60 if available
Passport-size photograph
Proof of address if Aadhaar address differs
eligibility_summary: Any Indian citizen, with account opening for minors above 10 years of age, who does not already have a bank account. Any individual can open an account.
exclusions: Persons already holding a regular bank account are not the primary target, though conversion rules apply as per bank guidelines
financial_assistance: Zero-balance bank account with RuPay debit card and overdraft facility up to Rs. 10,000 for eligible account holders after satisfactory operation.
how_to_apply: Apply at any bank branch or Bank Mitra outlet with Aadhaar and photograph, or through the bank's account opening form.
source: Department of Financial Services - PMJDY Guidelines (DRAFT - verify against official guideline before submission)

benefits: High interest rate notified by the Government for the scheme, compounded yearly
Deposits qualify for tax deduction as notified under the Income Tax Act
Partial withdrawal up to 50% of balance for higher education of the girl child after age 18
Account can be opened at post offices and authorised bank branches
description: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana is a small-deposit savings scheme for the girl child, to support her higher education and marriage expenses, with tax benefits under the Income Tax Act as notified.
documents_required: Birth certificate of the girl child
Aadhaar and PAN / identity proof of parent or guardian
Address proof of parent or guardian
Passport-size photographs
KYC form of the post office / bank
eligibility_summary: A girl child below 10 years of age. Only one account per girl child, and a maximum of two accounts per family except in case of twin / triplet girl children.
exclusions: Girl child above 10 years of age at the time of opening, except as allowed in special cases notified by the Government
More than one account for the same girl child
More than two accounts per family except for twin / triplet girls
financial_assistance: Deposit Rs. 250 to Rs. 1,50,000 per financial year. The account matures after 21 years from opening or on marriage of the girl child after age 18, as per rules.
how_to_apply: Open the account at a post office or authorised bank branch with the girl child's birth certificate and guardian's KYC documents.
source: Department of Economic Affairs - Sukanya Samriddhi Account Rules (DRAFT - verify against official notification before submission)

benefits: Collateral-free loans as per bank / MFI lending norms
Loans for working capital and term needs of micro enterprises
MUDRA Card facility for working capital as per bank rules
Interest subvention / support where notified by the Government
description: PMMY provides loans to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises for income-generating activities in manufacturing, trading, services and allied agriculture activities.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card and PAN Card
Proof of business address and business plan / project report
Bank statements for the previous period as required by the lender
Proof of category / licence / registration if applicable
Quotation of items to be purchased, if applicable
eligibility_summary: Indian citizens with a viable business plan for a non-farm micro / small enterprise, including proprietors, partnership firms, SHG members and small companies as per lender norms.
exclusions: Applicants who are defaulters of any bank / financial institution
Businesses that do not meet the lender's viability and KYC norms
Large corporate enterprises outside the micro / small enterprise definition
financial_assistance: Shishu: up to Rs. 50,000. Kishore: above Rs. 50,000 up to Rs. 5 lakh. Tarun: above Rs. 5 lakh up to Rs. 10 lakh. Tarun Plus: above Rs. 10 lakh up to Rs. 20 lakh for successful Tarun borrowers.
how_to_apply: Apply at any bank, NBFC or microfinance institution with a business plan, or through the Udyamimitra portal / JanSamarth portal.
source: MUDRA / Department of Financial Services - PMMY Guidelines (DRAFT - verify against official guideline before submission)

benefits: Guaranteed minimum pension after age 60
Spouse continues to receive the same pension after the subscriber's death
Nominee receives the accumulated pension wealth on death of both subscriber and spouse
Auto-debit of contributions from the linked savings bank account
description: Atal Pension Yojana guarantees a fixed monthly pension after the age of 60 to workers in the unorganised sector, with the pension amount depending on the contribution and entry age.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card
Savings bank account / post office savings account details
Mobile number linked to the account
Nominee details
eligibility_summary: Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 years with a savings bank account or post office savings account. Income-tax payers from 1 October 2022 are not eligible to newly enrol.
exclusions: Persons below 18 years or above 40 years of age
Persons without a savings bank / post office savings account
Income-tax payers enrolling on or after 1 October 2022
financial_assistance: Guaranteed pension of Rs. 1,000, Rs. 2,000, Rs. 3,000, Rs. 4,000 or Rs. 5,000 per month after age 60, depending on the chosen pension slab and contributions.
how_to_apply: Enrol at a bank branch or through net banking by filling the APY registration form and choosing a pension slab.
source: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority - APY Guidelines (DRAFT - verify against official guideline before submission)

benefits: Recognition as a Vishwakarma with ID card and certificate
Basic and advanced skill training with stipend
Toolkit incentive of Rs. 15,000
Credit support, digital transaction incentive and marketing support
description: PM Vishwakarma supports traditional artisans and craftspeople working with their hands and tools in 18 notified trades, through skill training, toolkit support, credit and marketing assistance.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card
Mobile number linked with Aadhaar
Bank account details
Ration Card if available
Proof of occupation / trade
eligibility_summary: Artisan or craftsperson aged 18 years or above, working in one of the 18 notified traditional trades in the unorganised sector on a self-employment basis, and not having taken loans under PMEGP / PM SVANidhi / Mudra in the last 5 years as per scheme rules.
exclusions: Persons below 18 years of age
Government employees and their family members
Persons who have availed PMEGP, PM SVANidhi or Mudra loans in the last 5 years, as per scheme rules
Trades not in the notified list of 18 trades
financial_assistance: Collateral-free enterprise loans in two tranches: Rs. 1 lakh first, then Rs. 2 lakh, at a concessional interest rate of 5% per annum, plus toolkit incentive and training stipend as per scheme rules.
how_to_apply: Enrol free of charge at a Common Service Centre with Aadhaar, followed by verification by the Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
source: Ministry of MSME - PM Vishwakarma Guidelines (DRAFT - verify against official guideline before submission)

benefits: Rs. 2 lakh life insurance cover
Low annual premium of Rs. 436
Renewable every year
Cover available through the subscriber's bank account
description: PMJJBY is a renewable term life insurance scheme for bank account holders, providing life cover to the family on death of the subscriber due to any reason.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card
Bank account details
Consent-cum-declaration form for auto-debit
Nominee details
eligibility_summary: Individual bank / post office account holders aged 18 to 50 years, with consent for auto-debit of premium. Cover continues up to age 55 on renewal as per scheme rules.
exclusions: Persons below 18 years or above 50 years at enrolment
Persons without an individual bank / post office account
Multiple accounts of the same person are not eligible for duplicate cover
financial_assistance: Life cover of Rs. 2,00,000 on death of the subscriber, for an annual premium of Rs. 436, auto-debited from the bank account.
how_to_apply: Apply at the bank branch holding your account, or through net banking / mobile banking, by submitting the consent form before 31 May for the cover year.
scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
source: Department of Financial Services - PMJJBY Guidelines (DRAFT - verify against official guideline before submission)

benefits: Accident death and disability cover
Very low annual premium of Rs. 20
Renewable every year up to age 70
Auto-debit from the bank account
description: PMSBY is an accident insurance scheme for bank account holders, providing cover for accidental death and disability.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card
Bank account details
Consent-cum-declaration form for auto-debit
Nominee details
eligibility_summary: Individual bank / post office account holders aged 18 to 70 years, with consent for auto-debit of premium.
exclusions: Persons below 18 years or above 70 years of age
Persons without an individual bank / post office account
Duplicate cover through multiple accounts of the same person
financial_assistance: Rs. 2,00,000 for accidental death or total irrecoverable disability, and Rs. 1,00,000 for partial disability, for an annual premium of Rs. 20.
how_to_apply: Apply at the bank branch holding your account, or through net banking / mobile banking, by submitting the consent form.
source: Department of Financial Services - PMSBY Guidelines (DRAFT - verify against official guideline before submission)

benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection in the name of an adult woman
EMI option for stove and refill cost
Targeted subsidy on LPG refills as notified
Health benefit from smoke-free cooking
description: PMUY provides deposit-free LPG connections to adult women from low-income households that do not already have an LPG connection, to replace polluting cooking fuels.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of the applicant and adult family members
State-issued ration card or family ID
Address proof
Bank account details
Self-declaration for Ujjwala 2.0 applicants where applicable
Passport-size photograph

eligibility_criteria.target_group: Adult women in households without LPG

eligibility_summary: Adult woman aged 18 years or above from a household without an existing LPG connection, belonging to SECC 2011 list, SC/ST, PMAY-G, Antyodaya, forest dwellers, island / river island residents, tea garden workers, or other categories notified, including households left out in Ujjwala 2.0 on self-declaration.
exclusions: Households that already have an LPG connection in the name of any member
Applicants below 18 years of age
Male applicants, as the connection is issued in the name of an adult woman of the household
financial_assistance: Deposit-free LPG connection with EMI facility for the stove and first refill as per scheme rules, and targeted subsidy as notified by the Government.
how_to_apply: Apply online on pmuy.gov.in or at an LPG distributor with the KYC form, or through a Common Service Centre.
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
source: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas - PMUY Guidelines (DRAFT - verify against official guideline before submission)
